description: Retrieves paginated analytics data on variable usage from a specified Figma library, grouped by 'file' or 'variable', for libraries with enabled analytics.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination, from a previous response's `cursor` field if `next_page` was true. Omit for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

file_key.description: Key of the Figma library file (from its URL) for which to retrieve variable usage analytics. Must be a published library from an Enterprise plan organization.
file_key.title: File Key

group_by.description: Dimension for grouping analytics data, determining the structure of `rows` in the response ('file' or 'variable').
group_by.title: Group By

name: get_library_analytics_variable_usage_data

data.description: Paginated analytics data for variable usage from the specified library.
data.title: Data

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; present if `next_page` is true.
cursor.title: Cursor

next_page.description: Indicates if more data is available. If true, `cursor` is provided for the next page.
next_page.title: Next Page

rows.description: Array of analytics data: `Row` objects if `group_by` was 'variable', or `Row1` objects if `group_by` was 'file'.
rows.title: Rows

collection_key.description: Unique and stable key of the variable's collection.
collection_key.title: Collection Key

files_using.description: Total distinct files in the organization using this variable.
files_using.title: Files Using

teams_using.description: Total distinct teams in the organization using this variable.
teams_using.title: Teams Using

usages.description: Total times this variable is used across the organization.
usages.title: Usages

variable_key.description: Unique and stable key of the variable.
variable_key.title: Variable Key

file_name.description: Name of the file using variables from the library.
file_name.title: File Name

team_name.description: Name of the team owning the file that uses library variables.
team_name.title: Team Name

usages.description: Total times variables from the specified library are used in this file.
usages.title: Usages

workspace_name.description: Name of the workspace for the file using library variables; may be null.
workspace_name.title: Workspace Name
